Beautiful place!
Jul 2019 • Solo
Wonderful and peaceful place surrounded by blooming lotus. Very wide menu which seemed almost entirely vegan to me - some meals contain butter or cheese. I had a bánh xèo which was stuffed with oignon, carrot and mung beans sprouts. It had a lovely crisp but was quite bland. It tasted good with the sauce though. And mushrooms with roasted peanuts. These were lovely but the serving is quite small so I would advise having some rice with them. There is also chili in the sauce so be careful if you can't eat spicy. 
Fair prices, nice and attentive waiters and quick service.

A beautiful temple nearby (Chùa An Dưỡng)

awesome location & awesome food
Apr 2017 • Family
Friends suggested the place & we went there for a Sunday lunch; and although I'm not much of an "hardcore vegetarian" I was impressed.
First of all there is the setting writhing a rice field, very peaceful & quiet. (a nice break from the busy beaches of Nha Trang) 
But more so, I found all of my favorite Vietnamese dishes represented. It was all prepared very authentic, and very tasty!
And after the meal I did not even miss any protein, as it was all rich & healthy too.
A "must" recommend is the salty lemonade, one of my favorite drinks on a hot day, but this one even better!!!
In short, a good place to go and enjoy a quality meal in a great Vietnamese setting 👍

Awesome place
Mar 2016 • Family
We live in Nha Tranh..When my husband suggested this place..frankly I had my doubts.. I couldnt see many reviews on TA as my reference but we still thought lets at least go n see..if not we will have coffee.. but NO I was wrong.. This is slightly away.. around 5 kms fm center of Nha Trang... we went looking through the GPS.. and wow its a beautiful, very quite place surrounded by the rice paddy fields..we ordered fresh mango salad, grilled mushroom which they grilled in front of us, one tofu dish and one fried rice.. The mango salad was awesomely fresh.. the tofu dish was ok n the fried rice was awesome again ... We also ordered drinks one blueberry juice, one apricot juice and 1 lemonade.. the lemonade was the best of the three drinks... It was very cheap too.. we spent around 10 dollars for ghe whole meal... perfect..l go there again for sure..A big thumbs up :-)
